name: AmeriCommerce
description_en:
AmeriCommerce by Cart.com is a hosted commerce platform focused on complex B2B and multi-store requirements. It combines catalogues, customer-specific selling, subscriptions, payment and fulfilment capabilities rather than only a simple consumer storefront.

Its multi-store model lets several branded stores share products and linked inventory through one administration console. Storefront Operations, design, migration and custom development are separately described services; platform access alone should not be assumed to include ongoing store management.
description_zh:
AmeriCommerce by Cart.com 是侧重复杂 B2B 和多店需求的托管电商平台，结合商品目录、按客户销售、订阅、支付及履约功能，不只是简单消费者网店。

多店模型可让不同品牌店共享商品和关联库存，通过一个后台管理。Storefront Operations、设计、迁移及定制开发属于另行介绍的服务，平台访问不能直接视为包含持续店铺代运营。

core_features.explanation_en: Link inventory so purchases in one storefront affect availability in another.
core_features.explanation_zh: 关联库存，使一家店的购买影响另一家的可售量。

core_features.explanation_en: Use separate themes and administrator permissions while managing stores centrally.
core_features.explanation_zh: 集中管理时仍可分别配置主题及管理员权限。

core_features.explanation_en: The platform lists wholesale segmentation, subscriptions and advanced pricing rules.
core_features.explanation_zh: 平台列有批发分组、订阅及高级定价规则。

sections.title_en: Sell one stock pool through retail and wholesale stores
sections.title_zh: 通过零售与批发店销售同一库存池
sections.en: A brand could run a public retail site and a separate wholesale storefront with linked products and stock. The multi-store page says a purchase on Store A can affect inventory on Store B, while themes and permissions vary by store. For evaluation, place an order on each side and inspect stock, customer visibility and the central order dashboard. This is a proposed check, not a tested inventory guarantee.
sections.zh: 品牌可经营公开零售站和独立批发店，并关联商品及库存。多店页说明 A 店购买可影响 B 店库存，同时各店主题和权限可不同。评估可分别下单，核对库存、客户可见性及集中订单后台。这是建议检查，非已测试库存保证。

sections.title_en: Plan shared assets and customer boundaries
sections.title_zh: 规划共享素材与客户边界
sections.en: The vendor recommends keeping images in a shared folder if more stores will be added later. Decide which catalogue fields and inventory are shared and which pricing, customers or content remain store-specific. Full HTML/CSS theme access does not establish access to the hosted platform’s source code. Define a representative wholesale account and a retail guest before evaluating visibility rules.
sections.zh: 厂商建议未来增加店铺时将图片放在共享目录。应确定哪些目录字段和库存共享，哪些价格、客户或内容按店区分。完整主题 HTML／CSS 访问不等于拥有托管平台源码。可先准备批发账户和零售访客，核对可见规则。

sections.title_en: Separate platform, stores and professional services
sections.title_zh: 区分平台、分店及专业服务
sections.en: The homepage’s pricing link returned 404 during research. An official contact page remains available for business scoping, and the site separately offers migration, design, custom features and Storefront Operations. No current numeric price or billing unit was verified. Request a quote listing storefronts, catalogue scale, payment costs, integrations and services rather than reusing historical public plan amounts. The trial invitation is not evidence of permanent free use.
sections.zh: 研究时主页定价链接返回 404，官方联系页仍可讨论需求；网站另列迁移、设计、定制功能和 Storefront Operations。未核实当前金额或计费单位。应按店铺数、目录规模、支付费用、集成和服务询价，不能沿用历史公开套餐金额。试用邀请不等于永久免费。

sections.title_en: Use multi-store complexity as the selection criterion
sections.en: Wholesalers and brands with distinct storefronts and a shared operational catalogue have a clear reason to evaluate it. A small single-store seller may not need its administration model. Check cancellations, returns and simultaneous orders before migration because the pages do not establish the exact stock-locking or retry behaviour. No payment, fulfilment, recovery, open-source licence or self-hosted installation was tested or verified.
sections.zh: 具有独立店面和共享运营目录的批发商及品牌有明确评估理由。小型单店卖家可能不需要这种后台模型。迁移前应检查取消、退货及同时下单，页面未说明具体库存锁定和重试行为。本文未执行支付、履约或恢复，也未核实开源许可及自托管安装。
